finding_reviews.rationale: Coverage and row conclusions hold: bczb output/shadow/page_rule_findings.csv flags exactly ROW-6900c35a75241a00 (published 'Minerva Merger Sub, Inc.', XBRL member of context i0bf60ca65f644ec79a3a1197c87a1ea0_I20220930 is the same text) and ROW-fb32f9352d6dcfba (member 'Petco Health & Wellness Co, Inc.'); published par/cost/FV/maturity match the printed lines. Minerva vs printed Athenahealth is a real name difference under the printed-name convention (a stale pre-merger issuer name, not a shifted member); Petco is a filer truncation. REJECTED for the stated mechanism and next action. The report says the bcza rename was let through by the amendment escape in position_matching._maturity_veto_sql. The data rule that out: the bcza edge (position_matches.parquet) is B2_exact_name from begin 'Athenahealth, Inc.' 2022-09-30 (principal 7,146,000, basis_spread NULL, maturity 2030-02-15) to end 'athenahealth, Inc.' 2022-12-31 (principal 36,931,000, spread 3.5, maturity 2029-02-15). The PA escape needs a ratio <= 1.02 (here 5.17); the spread escape needs both spreads non-null (begin is NULL). Neither escape can fire. The veto passes on its first branch, 'either maturity unknown': every dated BCRED row in bcza/bczb has maturity_precision 'unknown' (22,361 ixbrl_field_status + 9 null-source), so financial_conventions.maturity_interval_sql returns NULL _mat_low/_mat_high and the veto (and _mat_rank tie-break) is inert for the whole fund. This is the report's own observation maturity-precision-unknown-for-page-read-maturity, not linked to the Minerva blocker. Required correction (report text only, no build): replace the amendment-escape hypothesis with this mechanism and retarget next_action: either the precision mapping for ixbrl_field_status (shared, cohort re-match must be measured) or a fixed-vs-floating / maturity veto that does not depend on precision; keep the regression fixture (2022-09-30 notes, 2022-12-31 loan and notes). Side note: in nbbcc/bczb, A_within_filing edges for pid d9953922 (2022-12-31 -> 2023 quarters) carry begin_principal 3,297,000, the 2030 notes' par, because Tier A pairs LOWER(identifier) and the loan and notes differ only by case; returns that read begin values from position_matches inherit it. Also the 2022-12-31 2030 fixed notes are published with basis_spread 6.5 (the coupon).

request_reviews.rationale: Misclassified. pipeline/candidate_rules.issuer_name_differs_from_page states, under the owner's 2026-11-10 check repair: 'Any other difference still flags: a character, a space the page prints and the name lacks, a cut name ...'. Flagging a cut name is a recorded owner decision, so tolerating it is an acceptance_change for the owner, not a verification_bug. As worded it also would not work and could pass real errors: (1) 'Petco Health and Wellness Comp' is not a prefix of 'Petco Health & Wellness Co, Inc.' even after &/and folding ('comp' vs 'co'), so a prefix rule needs fuzzy matching; (2) a prefix test passes CLO series cuts ('Pikes Peak CLO 1' is a prefix of 'Pikes Peak CLO 10') whenever the fund also prints the longer name, which BCRED does; (3) BCRED 2022-09-30 has blocks of members shifted by one line, and a neighbour sharing a long prefix would pass. If the owner wants it, the guard should require: the full name printed on the same context's comparative or another line with the same XBRL member, the printed cell ending mid-token, a minimum length, no digit at the cut, and tests that Minerva vs Athenahealth, CLO 1 vs CLO 10 and a shifted neighbour still fail. Measure on accepted sandboxes per the check-repair rule.
